title: Permit Renewal Lead-Time Trend
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:permit trade=* renewal_lead_days=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(renewal_lead_days) as metric by _time trade
| sort 0 _time trade
description: Trends monthly renewal lead days by trade for permit renewals.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether permit renewals are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `trade` on `reno:permit` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly renewal lead days.
visualization: Line chart of monthly renewal lead days by trade.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how renewal lead days changes month by month for each trade so you can see whether permit renewals are heading the right way.
